# UrPassport NG

UrPassport NG is a web app that helps Nigerians handle passport renewal, visa
applications, flight search, and trip planning from one account.

## What it does

- Passport Hub: tracks a Nigerian passport renewal against a document
  checklist, plus a client-side NIN match checker that never sends the NIN
  anywhere.
- Visa Assistant: covers all 193 countries. Four (UK, US, Canada, UAE) have
  fully researched guides with a saved, trackable application. The rest pull
  live visa-requirement status from a third-party API.
- Document Vault: private, per-user file storage for travel documents, with
  expiry-date tracking and reminder emails.
- Flights: real flight search and fare holding via the Amadeus API.
- AI Trip Planner: generates a day-by-day itinerary from a destination,
  dates, and budget.
- Billing: Paystack checkout for a small set of paid add-ons.
- Family: manage passport/visa applications on behalf of dependants.

## Access

Everything past the homepage and login requires a Supabase-authenticated
account. There is no public API.

## Contact

Not affiliated with the Nigeria Immigration Service or any government body.
